### Problem

The report in #780 describes a defect, and the reproduction confirmed it: a workflow test written from the report fails on the default branch at `58cf1158d98c9805e62e9c5d425e25fcaaa0fd19` (https://github.com/DiluxOne/.github/actions/runs/43793945650).

Reproduction test: `tests/repro/test_issue_780.py`, SHA-256 `db2e3ab9c3b487a2754d51ab1ca7dbe79a859696f2c817ce9c4c274e0e57ada0`, on the branch `test/repro-issue-780`.

Reproduction way: `workflow`, run by scripts/repro-run.sh as `{"junit":"build/dx-repro-junit.xml","minutes":10,"run":"PYTHONPATH=\"$PWD/.dx-pytest\" PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider --rootdir=. -o junit_family=xunit1 --junitxml=build/dx-repro-junit.xml tests/repro/test_issue_780.py","setup":["python3 -m pip install --quiet --disable-pip-version-check --target .dx-pytest pytest==9.1.1 PyYAML==6.0.3"],"test":"tests/repro/test_issue_780.py"}`.

The test is the specification: it asserts what the report expected. It was written from an outsider's text, so it runs only the way it was written, in the reproduction's sandbox (scripts/repro-run.sh: the way's setup before the test is in the tree, then the test alone as a user of its own, with no environment, no secrets and no network but the machine's), never in the autopilot's working tree.

### Scope

- Fix the defect the reproduction test exercises, in the code it exercises.
- Add the reproduction test to the default branch, exactly as written.

### Out of scope

- Changing, moving, skipping or deleting the reproduction test: it is the evidence, and gate G7 checks its SHA-256.
- Any other behaviour the report mentions that the test does not exercise: a new issue.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given the reproduction test tests/repro/test_issue_780.py exactly as written, when it runs on the fix, then it passes, where it failed on 58cf1158d98c.

### Criticality

Normal
